XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Air conditioning

  • Device: Front recirculation air flap

  • Fault: After replacing the microfilter, the air flow in the passenger compartment and the cooling power are significantly reduced

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Replacing the microfilter may cause the front recirculation air flap to be crushed, compromising its opening and closing

• Action: Deactivate the air recirculation button on the air conditioning control module, remove the microfilter and the fan motor. If the recirculation flap is in a different position from that shown in the image, correct its position manually.

    If the fault persists, replace the flap itself.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Notes: To avoid the fault described in the following bulletin, when inserting the microfilter, it is important to ensure that the air recirculation function on the air conditioning control element is activated, i.e. that the recirculation air flap is closed.
